method: Li2025 preference model reduction (v2 source adaptation)
selection_rule: minimum normalized original-constraint violation among predicted top-k, Eq. (21)
b_normalization: infinity norm of finite canonical constraint RHS, including equality RHS
decode: selected inequalities plus permanent original variable bounds and all integer values; dual-certified cached KKT or actual HiGHS reduced LP

actual_final_optimizer.selection: minimum full-training objective across retained original-grid states; stable grid-order ties

selected_state_loss_semantics: Fresh rowwise CPU evaluation after restoring the selected actual retained state
history_semantics: Complete terminal pre-update history of the selected LR; its last row is not the retained-state loss
final_training_epochs_semantics: Epochs per nondegenerate LR fit; every configured epoch is executed for each original-grid LR

final_optimizer_trials.history_semantics: Epoch0 full eval; subsequent mean minibatch losses before their optimizer updates
final_optimizer_trials.post_history_semantics: Full training batch in original order, eval mode, after optimizer updates

final_optimizer_trials.history_semantics: Epoch0 full eval; subsequent mean minibatch losses before their optimizer updates
final_optimizer_trials.post_history_semantics: Full training batch in original order, eval mode, after optimizer updates

final_optimizer_timing.incremental_definition: Additional LR trials in full plus added post-update evaluation, snapshot, restore and retained-state diagnostics for the development-selected LR; measured stages, not a causal baseline timing comparison

top_k_clipping_scope: development SetCover size; duplicate effective candidate counts removed
matched_inference_adaptation: Native selected top_k and Eq21 winner strategy, then common-coordinate weighted agreement fixes D-K
